releaseNotes: Per-title theming: pages now pick up colors from each title's own artwork. Subtitle reposition: new orientation-aware subtitle position — Low in portrait, Middle in landscape, plus an Auto mode that re-anchors subtitles the moment you rotate. Full subtitle toolkit: sidecar subtitle files straight from the source's own pool (with download and attach retries), an auto-sync engine that stays attached across seeks, and online subtitle search inside the player. Refreshed detail and browse pages: reworked hero, expanded list pages with chips, rails and an episode strip, and ranked search that puts the best title match first. Fixes: Continue Watching no longer plays the wrong episode after you finish one — auto-resume now notifies the player pipeline, so the card you pick and the stream that plays are the same episode; the subtitle sheet can no longer show the previous episode's results after you switch episodes; manual server picks are no longer ignored (picker and playback now agree); the legal gate no longer reappears after dismissal; cold-start 'all sources failed' shows an error card instead of silently dropping into a fallback embed; stream picker and sheets pre-mount as soon as links land so taps respond sooner. Also: /movie/:id and /tv/:id deep links open the app directly via Android App Links, new MovieBox and Bing sources, HDHub download pages, and better download ranking.
